descriptionPlain:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.
The Stream Reporting team is responsible for capturing and processing the consumption signals that power some of Spotify’s most important experiences and business functions. Our systems help ensure accurate royalty reporting, support experimentation and analytics, and provide trusted data that informs recommendations and personalization across Spotify.
We’re looking for an Android Engineer to join a highly collaborative team working at the intersection of mobile development, data, and platform systems. This is an opportunity to build software that operates at Spotify scale and helps power experiences used by millions of listeners every day. You’ll help shape how listening and engagement signals are captured across Spotify’s mobile experiences and transformed into trusted datasets used throughout the company.

The Stream Reporting team is responsible for capturing and processing the consumption signals that power some of Spotify’s most important experiences and business functions. Our systems help ensure accurate royalty reporting, support experimentation and analytics, and provide trusted data that informs recommendations and personalization across Spotify.

We’re looking for an Android Engineer to join a highly collaborative team working at the intersection of mobile development, data, and platform systems. This is an opportunity to build software that operates at Spotify scale and helps power experiences used by millions of listeners every day. You’ll help shape how listening and engagement signals are captured across Spotify’s mobile experiences and transformed into trusted datasets used throughout the company.

lists.content:
• Develop and maintain mobile client components that capture and report listening and user behavior signals across Spotify.

  • Build high-quality, well-tested, and well-documented Kotlin code that contributes to business-critical datasets used for royalty reporting, analytics, experimentation, and personalization.

  • Collaborate with engineers across Android, iOS, backend, and data teams to deliver end-to-end solutions.

  • Help improve the architecture, reliability, and quality of the systems used to collect and process user behavior signals.

  • Contribute to new capabilities that enable Spotify to capture richer listening and engagement signals across evolving product experiences.

  • Drive technical improvements that make it easier for teams across Spotify to add, validate, and maintain event reporting integrations.

  • Use modern AI-assisted engineering tools and workflows to improve productivity and software quality.

  • Contribute to a culture of continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and technical excellence.

• You have experience developing Android and iOS applications using Kotlin using Swift or Objective-C

  • You have solid experience as a Engingeer I

  • You know how to build maintainable, scalable, and well-tested software systems.

  • You are comfortable working within large codebases and can quickly learn unfamiliar domains and technologies.

  • You have experience collaborating with engineers and stakeholders across multiple teams.

  • You care about code quality, testing, documentation, and long-term maintainability.

  • You demonstrate curiosity, ownership, and a willingness to step outside your immediate area of expertise when needed.

  • You are comfortable using modern development tooling, including AI-assisted coding solutions.

  • You thrive in environments where learning and long-term growth are valued.

  • You might have experience with C++ and understand how native code integrates with Android and iOS applications.

  • You might have familiarity with SQL, analytics systems, or data engineering concepts.

  • You have experience with instrumentation, telemetry, event collection, or large-scale client-side data systems.

  • You have worked on mobile applications that operate at significant scale and reliability requirements.

• This role is based in London or Stockholm.

  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

descriptionPlain:
The Marketing team in Latin America defines and evolves how Spotify shows up across the region. We shape brand experiences that feel authentic, inclusive, and deeply rooted in music culture. In Mexico, our work connects artists, fans, and communities through bold storytelling and culturally fluent creative execution.
 
The Creative Director leads the local Creative and Production teams and is the primary creative decision-maker for Mexico. It brings local nuance, creative ambition, and strong leadership to marketing initiatives in the market. While focused on Mexico, the role sits within the broader Latin American organization and may contribute to regional projects where local creative leadership is required.
description:
The Marketing team in Latin America defines and evolves how Spotify shows up across the region. We shape brand experiences that feel authentic, inclusive, and deeply rooted in music culture. In Mexico, our work connects artists, fans, and communities through bold storytelling and culturally fluent creative execution.
 
The Art Director plays a critical role in defining and driving Spotify’s brand in the region. Working across disciplines, the Art Director ensures Spotify shows up in ways that feel authentic, inclusive, and deeply connected to music culture.

While focused on Mexico, the role sits within the broader Latin American organization and may contribute to regional projects where local creative leadership is required.

lists.content:
• Bring creative concepts to life through strong visual direction and design craft across music campaigns, artist programs, and editorial moments in Latin America.
  • Translate creative strategy and narratives into compelling visual systems that feel culturally fluent and distinctly Spotify.
  • Partner closely with Creative Directors, designers, marketers, and cross-functional teams to deliver cohesive and high-quality creative work.
  • Develop and execute visual assets across multiple formats, including digital, social, experiential, and in-product surfaces.
  • Ensure consistency with Spotify’s brand while pushing creative boundaries in ways that feel relevant to local music communities.
  • Collaborate with external partners and agencies, providing clear visual guidance and feedback.
  • Contribute to an inclusive and collaborative creative culture where diverse perspectives are valued and amplified.

• You have experience as an Art Director or senior visual creative within music, culture, entertainment, or a related creative industry.
  • You bring a strong visual point of view and a sharp eye for detail, composition, typography, and storytelling.
  • You have a deep understanding of Latin American culture and how visual language resonates across different markets in the region.
  • You are comfortable working across teams and disciplines, translating ideas into clear visual direction.
  • You care deeply about craft, representation, and inclusivity in creative work.
  • You are adaptable, organized, and able to manage multiple projects in a fast-moving environment.
  • You communicate clearly and welcome feedback as part of the creative process.

• This role is based in Mexico City, Mexico.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home. We ask that you come in 2-3 times a week.

descriptionPlain:
Spotify is looking for a short-term contractor for the Artist & Label Partnerships team in Vietnam. 
The Artist & Label Partnerships team are the face of Spotify to artists, managers, labels & distributors. Focusing on the Vietnamese music landscape, this role will serve as the point of contact for record labels, distributors and artists, ensuring that artists & their teams are familiar with Spotify standard methodologies, resources and tools. The role will closely support the cross-functional teams with on-platform promotion and off-platform artist marketing. 

Please note this is a fixed-term, 6 months, contractor role hired through a third party.
description:
Spotify is looking for a short-term contractor for the Artist & Label Partnerships team in Vietnam. 

The Artist & Label Partnerships team are the face of Spotify to artists, managers, labels & distributors. Focusing on the Vietnamese music landscape, this role will serve as the point of contact for record labels, distributors and artists, ensuring that artists & their teams are familiar with Spotify standard methodologies, resources and tools. The role will closely support the cross-functional teams with on-platform promotion and off-platform artist marketing.

Please note this is a fixed-term, 6 months, contractor role hired through a third party.

lists.content:
• Maintain positive partnerships across artist and label communities within Vietnam.
  • Support our key partners in Vietnam on Spotify tools, resources and insights.
  • Work closely with our cross functional teams to support artists and labels on priority releases in Vietnam
  • Collaborate with the regional Music team to ensure content strategies are localized and successfully executed.
  • Ensure Spotify has the best possible content offering in Vietnam and use this to further Spotify’s appeal to existing and new users.

• You have at least 3+ years of working experience in the music/entertainment industry. Regional and global experience would be an added advantage. 
  • Extremely well organized, dedicated with the ability to plan, deliver on tight deadlines and pay outstanding attention to detail.
  • You have a deep understanding and established network within the local music industry in Vietnam and have built relevant contacts with labels and artists to effectively collaborate with the community.
  • You have a strong background in music and technology and a consistent record with operations.
  • You have a strong grasp of content knowledge, music and cultural trends, artists, user engagement and behaviors. 
  • You have excellent stakeholder management skills. 
  • You have experience working within Vietnam and ideally across multiple markets within regional and global teams.
  • You are very fluent in written and spoken English and Vietnamese. 
  • And finally, a great teammate, adapt well to change, and always have a positive demeanor.
• This contract is based in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.

descriptionPlain:
We are looking for a strategic-minded, execution-oriented Artists & Label Partnerships Manager for Taiwan, to join Spotify’s Music team based in Taipei. In this role, you will be part of the Music team in Southeast Asia, reporting to the regional Head of Artists & Label Partnerships.
 
You will sit at the heart of the music ecosystem, moving between high-level release strategies and the day-to-day tactical execution that drives artist and business growth. This role is perfect for a music industry professional who thrives on building relationships and navigating the intersection of technology and creativity.
 
Our ideal candidate has fun at work and a desire to make a positive impact on the music industry as a whole. Above all, your work will impact the way the world experiences music and strengthen Spotify’s role as a trusted, culturally relevant voice in the music landscape. This role is based in Taipei and will require international travel occasionally.

lists.content:
• Focusing on the Taiwan music landscape, You will be the primary point of contact for local and global music partners based in Taiwan, ensuring that Spotify remains the most valued partner for artists and our industry partners, utilising on-platform promotion and off-platform marketing to ensure Spotify is the premiere platform for artist development
  • Develop and execute a holistic music strategy for Taiwan that aligns with regional business goals
  • You will contribute your expertise to various music-related projects within the company, executing on creative and cross-functional collaborations in the region and beyond, building impactful and innovative artist partnerships to enable artists and artist-fan engagement
  • You will proactively identify music trends, emerging talent and opportunities in the local and global music landscape, providing deep cultural and musical insights with the local SEA team to execute pivotal initiatives, your global counterparts on multi-market campaigns and other key internal partners & teams including editorial, artist marketing, consumer marketing, licensing and others
  • Support and educate our key partners across artists and labels communities in Taiwan on Spotify tools, resources and insights to encourage them and improve their daily business
  • Lead artists & label partnerships representation in high-impact cross-functional projects and strategic bets at both a regional and global level

  • You will demonstrate a team player spirit, a passion for performance-oriented analytics, and a solid understanding of Spotify’s role in the music industry both locally and globally
  • You are skilled at leveraging data and audience insights to support strategic decisions and build clear narratives
  • You are culturally aware, with the ability to critically evaluate music trends, emerging movements and audience behaviour beyond just data

descriptionPlain:
The Audiobooks Mission is a team in the Product & Technology organisation focused on the ecosystem and strategies of Audiobooks on Spotify. We work across both the creator and consumer audiobooks ecosystems, in order to get the best possible product to market with the best possible content.
Spotify's Audiobooks team is helping shape the future of audio storytelling by bringing the world's best audiobook experiences to millions of listeners. As Associate Manager, Audiobook Licensing & Author Partnerships, you'll play an important role in growing our catalog while building meaningful relationships across the independent publishing community.
You'll work with entrepreneurial authors, hybrid publishers, independent presses, and distribution partners to identify great content, negotiate commercial partnerships, and help creators succeed on Spotify. Working closely with cross-functional teams across Product, Editorial, Growth, Operations, and Finance, you'll help scale our audiobook business while creating exceptional experiences for both creators and listeners.
description:
The Audiobooks Mission is a team in the Product & Technology organisation focused on the ecosystem and strategies of Audiobooks on Spotify. We work across both the creator and consumer audiobooks ecosystems, in order to get the best possible product to market with the best possible content.

Spotify's Audiobooks team is helping shape the future of audio storytelling by bringing the world's best audiobook experiences to millions of listeners. As Associate Manager, Audiobook Licensing & Author Partnerships, you'll play an important role in growing our catalog while building meaningful relationships across the independent publishing community.

You'll work with entrepreneurial authors, hybrid publishers, independent presses, and distribution partners to identify great content, negotiate commercial partnerships, and help creators succeed on Spotify. Working closely with cross-functional teams across Product, Editorial, Growth, Operations, and Finance, you'll help scale our audiobook business while creating exceptional experiences for both creators and listeners.

lists.content:
• Identify and evaluate audiobook catalogs from independent authors, hybrid publishers, independent presses, and distribution partners that will resonate with Spotify listeners.
  • Negotiate audiobook licensing agreements and commercial partnerships that create long-term value for Spotify and our publishing partners.
  • Build trusted relationships across a diverse portfolio of independent publishers, distributors, and authors, serving as their primary strategic contact.
  • Develop creative partnership structures that support sustainable growth while meeting the evolving needs of creators and publishing businesses.
  • Use market insights, performance analytics, and commercial data to inform acquisition strategies and identify new partnership opportunities.
  • Partner with creators and publishers to optimize catalog performance, improve discoverability, and resolve operational challenges.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Editorial, Growth, Operations, Finance, and other cross-functional teams to improve partner experi

• You have 3+ years of experience in publishing, digital media, business development, content licensing, content partnerships, or a related field.
  • You have experience negotiating and closing commercial licensing, distribution, or partnership agreements.
  • You have a strong understanding of the independent publishing ecosystem, including indie authors, hybrid publishers, audiobook distributors, and digital publishing models.
  • You understand the unique opportunities and challenges facing entrepreneurial creators and independent publishing businesses.
  • You build trusted relationships and effectively influence a broad range of internal and external stakeholders.
  • You use data, financial insights, and market trends to inform commercial decisions and partnership strategies.
